value.definition: the domain or initiative whose work a seat answers to

invariants.statement: An assignment naming no page type is looked for under both members.
A person and a persona each extend a domain.
No member of this property admits plain text.
A misspelled assignment is refused rather than kept as text.
A subagent may name an assignment that is no page.

value.definition: when a collection was released, to the day or to the moment

invariants.statement: A release known only to the day is written as a day rather than as midnight.

value.definition: the properties a page type adds, and the inherited properties it narrows

invariants.statement: A page type declares the properties the page type adds.
A page type takes the rest from the type the page type extends.
Optional becomes required.
A length only falls.
A unique kind only narrows.
A declaration stating no unique kind takes the kind its property states.
Whether a property is carried once or many times never changes.
The shape a property has belongs to the property.
How a property is carried belongs here.
Which member a declaration is read as is told by the one field parting them.
A value is committed unless the declaration with that value says that value is not.
A value is open unless the declaration with that value says that value is not.

value.definition: what an effect carries, as an inner effect or as a named act

invariants.statement: An effect that delays or repeats carries its inner effect here.
An effect naming a special act names that act here.
Which of the two an effect carries follows from the kind that effect names.
